datasets.name: DataAccount
datasets.sql:
select
a.id,a.acc_no,a.name,a.val_acc,a.filial,c.inn
from
account a,customers c
where
(a.kli_ID=c.id)and
(a.close_dat is null) and a.kli_id=:acc_id and a.val_acc=0
order by a.acc_no

datasets.name: XS_BATCHS
datasets.sql:
select
  x.*, x.rowid, 
  a.acc_no,
  a.name,
  v.val_name, 
  f.name filial_name
from
  XS_BATCHS x ,
  account a, 
  avalute v,
  filial_t f
where
   x.acc_id = a.id and
   v.valute=a.val_acc and
   x.filial=f.id and
  (x.transdate>=:BeginDate and x.transdate<=:EndDate) and
   a.kli_id=:custid
 order by :Title

datasets.name: XS_BENEFICIARY
datasets.sql:
select
    x.rowid,
    x.*,
    v.val_name,
    b.name as BankName
from
    XS_BENEFICIARY X,
    avalute v,
    BankM b
where
   (x.batchID=:id)and
   (x.val_cod=v.valute)
  and (x.rec_bank_id=b.id)

datasets.name: XS_BatchsArchive
datasets.sql:

  x.*, x.rowid,
  a.acc_no,
  a.name,
  v.val_name,
  f.name filial_name
from
  XS_BATCHS_Archive x ,
  account a,

where

datasets.name: Data_Code

Union All
select CODE from xs_transtype_code where NAMEID in(1,5)
group by CODE  
order by code
